verdict: Caution: lend selectively to Kolhapur castings and forgings only where the borrower has proven power and fuel cover, a firm order book and a clean monthly stock statement; avoid the sub-scale, export-dependent foundries that the local press says are near closure.
title: Kolhapur castings & forgings: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What the business is, and where the cash sits
**A Kolhapur foundry buys scrap and alloy, melts it on gas or power, pours, machines and ships to auto and engineering buyers; cash is made on conversion, not on metal.** The melt is the cost centre: power, fuel and scrap move together, and the customer sets the price with a lag, so a spike in gas or scrap hits margin before it hits the invoice. Working capital sits in scrap inventory and in receivables from OEM buyers; capex is the furnace, the moulding line and the pollution-control kit, and it is lumpy. **So when a proposal lands, check the power and fuel line as a share of conversion cost and the receivable days by buyer; if the top buyer is over half of sales, ask for the purchase order and the payment history.**

## What has changed now
**The local press is blunt: 70% of Kolhapur district foundries were reported on the verge of closure in March 2026, on fuel shortage, transport cost and stalled exports [3], and the wider Maharashtra foundry belt was described as in unprecedented crisis on LPG shortage, raw-material price rise and tariff-hit exports [2].** Both are local newspaper reports from March 2026, so treat them as sentiment, not audited fact, and re-verify with the borrower. The official data is mixed: Maharashtra GST collections ran +8.6% Apr-to-date against India's +6.1% [D], but state electricity demand grew only +6.0% against India's +9.5% [D], which says local industrial load is not pulling. **So when a proposal lands, check the unit's own power consumption trend; if it is falling while the loan request is for capacity, ask why.**

## Where the growth is
**Peer results split cleanly: the forging side is growing and the casting side is flat.** Ramkrishna Forgings grew revenue 54.9% YoY to Rs 1,405 crore in Q2 FY27 with EBITDA margin at 18.23% and Rs 673 crore of new orders [6]; Happy Forgings carries a ~Rs 950 crore order book, ~60% export, to be executed over 2-3 years [5], and grew Q4 FY26 revenue 20.4% [7]. Against that, Nelcast's Q2 FY25 revenue fell to Rs 335 crore from Rs 362.6 crore on subdued CV demand [4] — an old result, but the direction is clear. **So pursue forging and machining units with a named order book and a domestic-plus-export mix; avoid pure castings units selling only to CV.**

## How to grow safely
**Structure for the melt, not the balance sheet: cash credit against stock, with the drawing power reset monthly on a stock-and-debt statement, and a term loan only where the capex is backed by a signed order.** Take the monthly power bill, the monthly stock statement and the quarterly GST return every month without exception. **If gearing is above 2x or interest cover below 2x, ask for a promoter infusion before enhancement; the rated peers run far cleaner — one ICRA-rated forging unit carries gearing close to nil and TOL/TNW at 0.3 times [8], and a CARA-rated forgecast improved Total Debt/GCA from 3.49x in FY22 to 1.56x in FY23 [10].** Note that Simplex Castings sits at Crisil BB/Stable [9] — that is the ceiling for a weak casting book, so price accordingly.

## Early warning
**Watch the gas bill, the scrap rate and the receivable days together; any two moving the wrong way in the same month is the signal.** A unit that shifts from LPG to cheaper fuel without telling you, or asks for a second limit within a quarter of the first, is the one to walk away from.
watch: Bill up more than 10% with flat sales -> ask for revised pricing and re-set drawing power
Stock ageing beyond 60 days or DP utilisation above 90% -> freeze enhancement, inspect godown
Turnover down two months running -> seek buyer-wise order book and re-rate limit
Top buyer beyond 90 days -> ask for buyer confirmation and insurance cover
Switch of fuel or lapsed consent -> stop disbursement until documents are produced
watch_note: Trigger levels are policy suggestions (analytical framing), not data.
